label: late original-phase steps (t>=6) in sequences that start with l
explanation: Fires only in the original phase and at the delimiter, never during copying. Almost all of it is at t=5-8 (peaks at t=6-7, orig_idx 6-8 has 9-12x lift), so in practice it shows up in long sequences (L>=7) near the end of the input, with to_go 0-2. 86% of activation mass is in sequences whose first original token is l (22x lift). Weak extra mass comes from sequences starting with i or m, or with l in position 1. Magnitude is highest at t=6-7 on later inputs such as h, x and 3; the max is on h at t=6. Delimiter activations are small (6% of mass). It never fires at t<=4 and never in the copy phase. Within the late steps of l-initial sequences, many steps stay silent depending on the input token, so precision is only about 0.47 and the predicate is incomplete (dev F1 0.51, mass recall 0.72).
